themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging migration crises to push for stricter border controls and anti-immigration policies. This theme is evident in Italy, Spain, and Hungary, where leaders like Giorgia Meloni, Santiago Abascal, and Péter Magyar are framing migration as a national security threat, often clashing with EU partners over border policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox demands stricter controls on migrant minors from Ceuta, accusing the government of treason and calling for a 'hygienic cordon' against the PSOE.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni suspends Schengen with Spain over Ceuta crisis, prioritizes border security, and clashes with Germany over migrant repatriations.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Magyar criticizes EU migration policies and frames Danube water management as a national security issue tied to energy independence.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP highlights secondary immigration costs and opposes EU migration policies, using the issue to criticize the government.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen demands a 'Marshall Plan' for firefighters and criticizes government handling of migration, linking it to national security.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, the U.S., and Hungary are pushing for fiscal austerity, often targeting social programs. This includes cuts to welfare, healthcare, and education funding, framed as necessary for economic stability but criticized as harmful to vulnerable populations.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei accelerates austerity measures, including cuts to healthcare and education, while negotiating electoral alliances for 2027.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration proposes cuts to Head Start, ACA subsidies, and social welfare programs, citing fiscal responsibility.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government amends budget laws to bypass debt rules, facing criticism for prioritizing energy projects over social spending.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's Reform UK proposes reducing welfare spending and tightening eligibility for social programs, framing it as a cost-saving measure.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS proposes deporting unemployed Ukrainian migrants, citing fiscal strain and national security concerns.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration in the U.S. is intensifying efforts to restrict gender-affirming care for minors and roll back LGBTQ+ protections. Similar rhetoric and policy proposals are emerging in Poland and Hungary, where right-wing governments are also targeting LGBTQ+ rights under the guise of 'traditional values.'

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump signs executive order to reduce childhood vaccines, including those for HPV, and JD Vance calls for DOJ investigations into gender-affirming care.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS continues to oppose LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as a threat to traditional Polish values and family structures.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza government bans circus animal acts but faces criticism for not addressing broader LGBTQ+ rights issues, maintaining Orbán-era policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's Reform UK opposes gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ protections, aligning with U.S. conservative rhetoric.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
